description: Map Studio component properties. The list is closed: later versions add properties here and in docs/.

popupView.description: Spike-only (story 4): the project view opened as a popup when a point is clicked, rendered the way the built-in Map renders a view from a path. The view receives the point as its 'mapItem' parameter ({id, name}) beside the params given here. A later version names the view in the kind setup instead (AD-7).

path.description: Path of the project view to show in the popup. Empty shows a text popup with the point id.

params.description: Parameters passed to the view beside 'mapItem'. Names must match input parameters defined on the view.
